booking_categories_hourly_check.name: booking_categories_hourly_check
booking_categories_hourly_check.value: "booking_categories"."type" <> 'hourly' or ("booking_categories"."weekday_rate_cents" is not null and "booking_categories"."weekend_rate_cents" is not null and "booking_categories"."min_duration_minutes" is not null and "booking_categories"."period" = 'single')

booking_categories_hour_package_check.name: booking_categories_hour_package_check
booking_categories_hour_package_check.value: "booking_categories"."type" <> 'hour_package' or ("booking_categories"."fixed_price_cents" is not null and "booking_categories"."included_minutes" > 0 and "booking_categories"."period" <> 'single')

subscriptions_one_hour_pkg.name: subscriptions_one_hour_pkg
subscriptions_one_hour_pkg.where: "subscriptions"."type" = 'hour_package' and ("subscriptions"."status" in ('active','suspended') or ("subscriptions"."status" = 'awaiting_payment' and "subscriptions"."switch_from_subscription_id" is null))
